contractCoverage.notes: Claim boundary post-fix: AC-L12-B unsorted refuse is enforced and tested at the exporting contract (exportpack selection_unsorted / test_an_unsorted_selection_is_refused). SPEC §14 no longer claims clause-for-clause AC-L12-B over the HTTP product path; it states every AC-L12-B refusal is verified at the exporting contract (which the route inherits for path/link/collision/selection/credential refusals) and that the route itself additionally refuses non-pinned/duplicate/empty and canonicalizes only presentation order of the pinned set. HTTP test_an_unsorted_selection_produces_the_canonical_sorted_manifest therefore matches the disclosed route boundary, not a silent sanitize of an AC-L12-B clause.
